exposure: Frequency of antenatal care (ANC) clinic visits
cohort: 5148 children aged 0-23 months born to adolescent mothers in India
finding: Infant and young child feeding (IYCF) practices among adolescent mothers in India were suboptimal, except for breastfeeding, with several factors like maternal education, mode of delivery, and ANC visits being associated with these practices.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant factor associated with breastfeeding practices.
